data.narrative:
HawkEye 360 is a Series D+ stage space technology company founded by Chris DeMay and John Serafini, having raised over $300M to date. The valuation analysis operates within a Space & Aerospace sector universe containing 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard triangulation methods proved inapplicable to this target. The peer-median approach failed due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage datapoints within the narrow Space & Aerospace set—only 14 same-sector peers exist, but none met the three-datapoint minimum after filtering for stage and valuation tier. Public-comp anchoring could not proceed absent the target's disclosed revenue; while the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median stands at 27.4x across the six public tickers identified, applying this multiple requires private company revenue disclosure, which HawkEye 360 does not provide.

Given the absence of applicable quantitative methods, no triangulated valuation range can be derived from the data on file. The analysis underscores a material constraint: Series D+ stage private aerospace companies typically operate under revenue confidentiality, limiting standard comparable valuation approaches. Establishing a defensible range would require either (1) target revenue disclosure, (2) identification of at least three same-stage private comparables with disclosed valuations, or (3) alternative methods such as discounted cash flow analysis, for which no forward guidance is available.
